description: Verified bank accounts (CLABE) per client — the payout/deposit destinations for the banking-first rails (SPEI via STP). A client registers a CLABE once, it is verified by micro-deposit or provider link, and disbursements/payouts are sent to the default verified account. See docs/payment-banking-first-redesign.md (Phase 1).

fields.name: clientId
fields.description: Owner of the bank account. Same id space as clients.clientId.

fields.name: clabe
fields.description: 18-digit CLABE interbancaria. Personal financial data under LFPDPPP: never log in full (redact to last 4), unique per client. Not PCI (cards only).

fields.name: bankCode
fields.description: 3-digit ABM bank code derived from the CLABE prefix (e.g. 014 Santander, 012 BBVA).

fields.name: bankName
fields.description: Human-readable bank name resolved from bankCode.

fields.name: holderName
fields.description: Account holder name as registered at the bank. Should match the client's verified KYC identity.

fields.name: isVerified
fields.description: True once ownership is proven. Defaults to false on create.

fields.name: verificationMethod
fields.description: How ownership was proven. Allowed values: micro_deposit, provider_link, manual. Lookup values live in database hints, not a separate field table.

fields.name: isDefault
fields.description: The account SPEI payouts/disbursements are sent to. Exactly one default per client; setting a new default clears the previous one.

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId — injected automatically by stored procedures.
A client can register multiple accounts; UNIQUE (clientId, clabe). Payouts use the default verified one.

components.name: BankAccountListStep
components.description: IonList of a client's registered CLABEs showing bank name, masked CLABE (···· last 4), verification badge and default marker.

components.name: BankAccountFormModal
components.description: IonModal create form: CLABE input (18-digit numeric with bank auto-detect from prefix), holder name prefilled from the client's KYC identity.

components.name: BankAccountVerifyStep
components.description: Micro-deposit confirmation: the client enters the centavos amount received; on match sets isVerified + verifiedAt via action 2.
